verdict.rationale: A government tax portal could plausibly offer user-configured background actions, so the axis applies. The only relevant evidence is an FAQ about opting into automatic direct debit (prélèvement automatique) for CFE, a fixed recurring payment the user switches on once that then runs without them. That barely counts as user-defined automation. Missing for 10: user-configurable automations or workflows, scheduled or triggered background tasks beyond payment debit, API or agent access, and any documentation or independent corroboration of autonomous automation features.
